contributions.statement: Compress agent trajectories only when context limits force it: every compression method lowered pass rate versus full context, LLM-summary compression cost more than no compression, and cheap masking of old observations halved cost at about 6 points lower pass rate.

reason: The method's advantage over baselines is within noise and it still loses to full context; the cost caution is already shown, with better statistics, by 2608.24188.
